scope: RGB-only pre-optimization availability audit on four known scenes; same descriptors before/after closed-cycle screening; no camera correction and no independent-object claim
limitations: Complete descriptor cycles do not guarantee physical identity
Keypoint centers outside guide strip; descriptor support may overlap it
All views share cell groups across tracks before splitting; no residual-dependent rebalance
F/H fits only diagnose availability and planar ambiguity; neither updates cameras
No model predictions, truth, or evaluation outputs are read by track inference
